title: Sparse chromatic graphs and the complete-graph triangle bound
summary: We prove that there is an absolute constant $c>0$ such that every graph of chromatic number at least $r$ and at most $cr^3\log^2 r$ edges contains at least $\binom r3$ triangles. The proof has three ingredients. First, a sparse-core argument based on a triangle-sensitive coloring estimate of Harris extracts, from any counterexample, an induced subgraph of order $O(r)$ and chromatic number at least $(1-η)r$.
